prompt: Build a pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using x402

spec.name: JokePayPerCall
spec.description: A pay-per-call joke API that charges 0.005 USDC per request using x402 protocol on Algorand

global_state.name: price_per_call
global_state.description: Price per call in microUSDC (5000 = 0.005 USDC)

local_state.name: calls_made
local_state.description: Number of jokes fetched by this user

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initialize joke service with price per call in microUSDC

methods.name: record_payment
methods.description: Record a verified x402 payment from the facilitator for one joke request

methods.name: get_joke
methods.description: Increment call counter and return a joke (payment must be recorded first)

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Get total number of joke calls served

ui_requirements: Service dashboard showing total jokes served and total USDC earned
Demo pay-per-call button that triggers the x402 pay-and-fetch flow
Price display showing 0.005 USDC per joke
Payment status indicator (unpaid / paid / joke delivered)
business_logic: Price is set at creation and stored on-chain in microUSDC
Each record_payment call increments total_calls and adds to total_earned
Only the service owner can withdraw earnings
get_joke requires the caller to have a recorded payment in the current session
Local state tracks per-user call count for usage analytics
